race.comment: JOHN OF JANE (1) was put aside after winning his debut here by over 5-lengths, and then should have won fresh up at Launceston when finishing second by a nose. He was found to be mildly lame in a hind leg that day, which is what cost him his perfect record. He is over that now, and gets to set the record straight with a win here. MISS LYRA (5) has been knocking on the door with 3 straight second-place finishes at Launceston. Her only win to date has been here over this trip, and another honest effort is on the cards. STAR PERFORMER (4) resumes from a spell, and she was fourth in a recent tune-up trial. She is nicely placed after a 2kg claim, and is worth including. OLINDAH (6) boomed home late to score fresh at Launceston, before running on too late there last time out over 1120m. Getting back out to 1200m will help her, ad having a more experience apprentice in the irons is also a positive change. Stick with her. GEEGEES ACE (3) has the blinkers on for the first time, so keep safe.
